comment: Deterministic TDX TDREPORT, v4 quote, RTMR event-log and SNP ID-block vectors. Generated from fixed keys; no hardware is involved and no vector marks an unverified structure as valid.

suites.source: Deterministic local generator using the Intel TDX 1.5 REPORTMACSTRUCT/TEE_TCB_INFO/TDINFO layout
Deterministic local v4 quote signed with fixed P-256 keys
Deterministic TCG2 crypto-agile log replayed with SHA-384
Deterministic SNP ID block and ID auth with fixed P-384 keys, parsed by the merged std/cvm/snp surface
